entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To ensure quality service, this call may be recorded. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns'.
RETURNS! Just get me a person now! This is unbelievable.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. I can hear you're upset, how can I help you today?
Yeah, you can help me by doing your job! I bought this ProFit jersey and it's completely the wrong size. I've been trying to get through for ages. This is ridiculous!
I'm very sorry for any frustration this has caused. I can certainly help you with the jersey. Do you have your order number available?
It's VF98765. And don't give me some runaround about it being too long. If I don't get a refund for this, I'm writing a review on every single website you can imagine. Get me your manager.

I understand your frustration, sir. I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing to escalate. Let me just pull up that order... VF98765. I see the ProFit Jersey was delivered 55 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes! And it's been sitting in the bag ever since because it's way too tight. I need to exchange it or get my money back.
Of course. Let me just check our policy for you... Okay, good news. The policy for our standard apparel, like this jersey, is a 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe.
Wait, really? So you're not going to fight me on this?
Not at all. We want to make sure you have gear that fits perfectly. Since the issue is the wrong size, we can absolutely process an exchange for you, or a full refund if you prefer. What works best?
Oh. Well, an exchange would be great, actually. I just need a Large. The Medium is just too tight in the shoulders.

Not a problem at all. I've just initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email on file right now. Just use that to send the medium jersey back, and as soon as it's scanned by the carrier, we'll ship out the Large to you.
Wow. Okay. That's... a lot easier than I expected. Sorry for yelling earlier.
It's completely understandable. I'm just glad I could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
